subject: SSQ: annotated dataflow, KMS custody proof, and onboarding checklist
messages:
-----Message 1-----
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Romero <natalie.romero@medsight.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_c@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SSQ intake + request for annotated dataflow and KMS evidence

Hi Natalie,

Thanks for sending over MedSight's security questionnaire last week. We reviewed the SSQ and have three items that need short-form evidence to complete your intake:

- Annotated dataflow diagram that highlights where PII is ingested, tokenized, cached, and persisted (if at all). A PNG or PDF with callouts is fine.
- KMS custody note: which keys (customer vs Redwood) will be used for telemetry/telemetry artifacts and whether a per-tenant key is required.
- A short onboarding checklist we can align on for subprocessor approvals and access provisioning (who signs off on service accounts, expected lead times).

Can you share the annotated diagram and indicate whether MedSight requires any key escrow or customer-controlled KMS for the pilot? If you have a single document that maps SSQ section numbers to our answers, please attach that instead.

We're aiming to finalize the SSQ review for the PO by 2026-01-15; if you can get the files by EOD 2026-01-12 that would help.

Thanks,

Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
-----Message 2-----
From: Natalie Romero <natalie.romero@medsight.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@medsight.io>
Date: 2026-01-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SSQ intake + request for annotated dataflow and KMS evidence

Hi Olga,

Thanks — attaching our SSQ (filled) and a preliminary network/dataflow PNG. Quick notes:

- We ingest end-user PII at the API gateway; we expect Redwood to pseudonymize/tokenize before storing any content in persistent logs. We call this out in section 3.2 of the attached SSQ.
- For the pilot, MedSight does not require a customer-controlled KMS, but for production we prefer a BYOK model. Can Redwood confirm whether BYOK is supported for Dedicated deployments?
- Onboarding: legal signs off on DPA annex; engineering verifies IAM roles. Typical lead time: 10 business days.

Attachments: medsight_ssq_v3.pdf, annotated-dataflow-20260108.png

Best,
Natalie Romero
Head of Security Operations
MedSight Health
-----Message 3-----

To: Natalie Romero <natalie.romero@medsight.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-12T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SSQ intake + request for annotated dataflow and KMS evidence

Hi Natalie — quick clarifying Qs inline:

1) The diagram shows a 'redwood-proxy' box that stores 'short-lived logs' — can you confirm expected retention for those logs in the pilot? (we can map to retention tiers)
2) For BYOK in production, do you need HSM-backed keys (HSM required) or is KMS sufficient (KMS with customer-managed keys)?

If you prefer, we can put Ben + Olga on a quick 30-min call to walk the diagram. We're available 2026-01-13 between 9–11am PT.

thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
-----Message 4-----
From: LegalOps <legalops@medsight.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_c@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Romero <natalie.romero@medsight.io>
Date: 2026-01-13T14:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SSQ intake + request for annotated dataflow and KMS evidence

Ben/Olga,

Re retention: pilot logs retained 7 days by default; production options: 7/30/90 days. We'll send a short policy excerpt.

Regarding keys: production requires HSM-backed keys; pilot may use customer-managed KMS (no HSM). For procurement, please send a short appendix describing Redwood's KMS options and whether Dedicated supports HSM-backed BYOK.

Also attaching a one-page onboarding checklist template we use internally — please confirm which items you need Redwood to complete prior to first ingest.

Attachment: onboarding-checklist-medsight.pdf

Regards,
MedSight Legal Ops
-----Message 5-----
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>

Hi team,

Got it — thanks for the attachments. Next steps from Redwood:

1) I'll draft a short KMS appendix (pilot vs production options) and share by EOD 2026-01-14.
2) Ben will confirm retention tiers mapping to our telemetry/trace pipeline and whether we can enforce a 7-day pilot retention window.
3) Lauren will own the onboarding checklist alignment and will mark which items Redwood will complete.

Proposed calendar: 2026-01-15 10:30am PT — 30-min call to finalize onboarding checklist and KMS appendix. Can you confirm availability?

Olga
